question: Related Questions Q. i live in saudi arabia.i have bald head,is it advicable to have a wig on my head. if yes, what should i do while doing UMRAH should i remove my hair or i can leave it as such. please advice. 5282 views Q. If i want to go for umrah and the public transport is not going to stop such a long time in which we can go in IHRAM can we go to jeddah meeqat for going in to IHRAM. 3987 views Q. One of my friends tells me that doing an umrah by wearing ahram from "masjid-e-Aisha" is permissible only for women folk and not for men. His explanation was that Nabi-e-Kareem Muhammad (Pbuh) asked aisha(radiallahu anha) to do umrah from "masjid-e-aisha" as she was sick during the time of Hajj, and her brother was not asked to do the same when he accompanied her. If this was permissible for men then Nabi-e-Kareem Muhammad (Pbuh)would have also asked him to do umrah from "masjid-e-aisha". My friend also tells me that according to Imam Abu Hanifa Rahmatulla alayh, such umrah is permissible for men but is makruh. Please quote to the exact hadith in discussion and explanation as to how and why it is permissible for men and also comment on the views of my friend. Jazakallahukhaira. 4361 views Q. I wish to take my mother and wife for HAJJ . But I have some business problems and creditors to pay ( I am writing my problems below in detail) so I am not sure if MY HAJJ WILL BE IN ORDER . I am doing business in the family but due to some disputes our business is on closure and we have bank interest and creditors to pay. I want to settle all the creditors by selling our land to avoid the WRATH OF ALLAH SUBHANAHO TAALAH , but my other associates are not ready for this. As we are all blaming each other for the problems and nobody is interested in settling the business creditors / bank as they all want some money for themselves before they are ready to settle the accounts. The situation is not improving and I want to take my mother and wife for HAJJ with my own personal busines money . Can you please advice, in the light of the Shariat , am I allowed to perform the HAJJ in this situation and will it be in order ? answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 10151 Country: India Title: 1.power theft is halal or haram 2.if aperson do umrah first then haj is wajib upon him or not Question: 1.power theft is halal or haram 2.if aperson do umrah first then haj is wajib upon him or not Answer ID: 10151 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 178/162=B/1429) (1) Power theft is haram . (2) If anyone performs umrah in the months of hajj i.e. Shawwal, Dhul Qadah and Dhul Hijjah, hajj will be fardh (obligatory) on him. So, if anyone performs umrah in these months he should perform hajj as well, but if has already performed his obligatory hajj then he is not required to perform it again. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
